title: On a train
topic: They are on a train. The standing person seems a little tired. The two people do not know each other. What does the person indicated by the arrow say?
levelRationale: N5-oriented expression matching, not English-translation recognition. Numbered choices differ in communicative purpose; tips explain less familiar scene vocabulary. Stock voices and exact output still require listening approval.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 絵を見て、話を聞いてください。矢印の人は、何と言いますか。答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Look at the picture and listen. What does the person indicated by the arrow say? Choose one answer.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 電車の中です。立っている人は、少し疲れているようです。二人は知り合いではありません。矢印の人は、何と言いますか。
turns.translation: They are on a train. The standing person seems a little tired. The two people do not know each other. What does the person indicated by the arrow say?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 1。どうぞ、ここに座ってください。
turns.spokenText: いち。どうぞ、ここに座ってください。

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 2。ここに座ってもいいですか。
turns.spokenText: に。ここに座ってもいいですか。

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 3。ここに荷物を置かないでください。
turns.spokenText: さん。ここに荷物を置かないでください。

options.label: どうぞ、ここに座ってください。
options.rationale: This offers the speaker's seat to the other person.

options.label: ここに座ってもいいですか。
options.rationale: This asks permission for the speaker to sit, rather than offering his own seat.

options.label: ここに荷物を置かないでください。
options.rationale: This prohibits placing luggage and does not offer the seat.

explanation: The picture identifies the marked person as the current seat occupant. The audio says the standing stranger seems tired. Offering that person the seat fits; asking permission to sit reverses the roles.

visual.description: Inside a train, person A is seated on the left and person B stands to the right holding a walking stick. A single arrow points to A. There is no text dialogue or selected answer.
